paper_claim: Human-centric autoregressive tuning creates transferable visual and decoder representations inside a VLM.
hypothesis: Jointly tuning Qwen Vision and the standard Qwen LLM decoder on a single person-aligned serialization of box, contour, pose, age, and gender will produce valid generated outputs and nontrivial dense human perception without specialist Stage-1 heads.
falsifier: Close this representation branch if it cannot overfit the frozen codec set, if generated-format validity is below 98 percent, or if the frozen full-pilot gate fails for either segment or pose under generated inference.
paper_destination: source representation for Stage-2 and Stage-3 transfer

representation.person_order: ascending body-box center x, then center y, with deterministic annotation-id tie break
representation.sequence: <person> box pose segment gender age </person> repeated for all persons
representation.pose: 17 ordered COCO joints, each represented by x, y, and visibility tokens
representation.segment: one or more contour spans sharing a total budget of 64 boundary points per person
representation.attributes: categorical gender token and integer age token
representation.decoder: native tied Qwen causal language-model head

trainable: Qwen Vision LoRA on qkv, attention output, and MLP projections in all 24 blocks (r=16, alpha=32)
Qwen LLM attention and MLP LoRA across all 32 blocks (r=16, alpha=32)
new input rows and tied LM-head rows
frozen: all original Qwen Vision weights outside LoRA
all original Qwen LLM weights outside LoRA
training.loss: active-task-balanced next-token cross-entropy only: average token CE inside each of box, pose, segment, gender, age, and structure spans before averaging active spans
training.missing_label_policy: preserve the owner person slot but mask value-token CE for unavailable annotations; never teach annotation missingness as a visual class

preprocessing.geometry: native aspect ratio with Qwen smart resize
preprocessing.decision: freeze exact resized shapes and token headroom in the 32-image interface smoke before G1

training.teacher_forcing: training mechanism only; all validation metrics use free generation
training.augmentation: image and all person labels undergo the same geometry; no augmentation may reorder person identity without reserialization

requirements: quantized boxes decode inside image bounds
multiple records produce distinct decoded masks
official no-small oracle AP proves the representation ceiling is not the active bottleneck
G0_codec.decision: G0 passed. Preserve contour64 and loc1000 through G1; representation changes require a separately admitted branch.

G1_overfit_64.decision: Failure closes or revises only the serialization, not the three-stage paper claim.

G2_pilot_generated_validation.decision: No full Stage-1 training if segment or pose remains at collapse level.

G3_full_stage1.validation_split: COCO-UniHuman val under paper-aligned no-small-person scoring
G3_full_stage1.decision: Stage-2 visual transfer starts only after all five capability requirements pass.

controls: S0_NATIVE_QWEN_NUMERIC_JSON as the unmodified true zero-shot baseline
S1_INIT_CODEC_0STEP with the exact Stage-1 loc-token grammar and zero optimizer steps as the matched initialization control
joint tuning with Qwen Vision frozen
joint tuning with LLM LoRA disabled
image shuffle on generated dense outputs
person-order perturbation evaluated without changing owner labels

cost.first_commitment: codec implementation and CPU unit tests only

reopen_policy: If contour serialization fails G2, a mask-token codec is a new branch requiring a new admission card; dense heads and external segmenters do not reopen this branch.
closure_reason: Codec oracle capacity does not establish free autoregressive learnability. The monolithic all-person sequence lacks matched prior evidence; closest successful sequence models condition pose/mask on one object box and report much lower mask AP than HQNet.
scientific_use: Retain contour64 and monolithic serialization only as a diagnostic ablation, never as the Stage-1 mainline.
